title: Generate a code-backed capability overview and quick start

events.title: Generate a code-backed capability overview and quick start
events.body:
## Outcome

Give a new contributor one generated, accurate entry point into the repository without slogans, provider comparisons, or manually maintained capability claims.

## Implementation

- Generate the public overview from executable compatibility probes, feature flags, deployment-boundary data, and versioned API schemas.
- Show implemented, limited, and unavailable behavior with a probe or schema identifier for every claim.
- Render exact clone, mirror, contribution, node-start, and self-host commands with copy actions.
- Explain canonical, cached, transient, encrypted, and locally held data using the deployment manifest from #457.
- Add a deployment-shape chooser based on required capabilities rather than comparisons with external products.

## Acceptance criteria

- No displayed capability can exist without a passing probe or a checked-in schema reference.
- Limitations and unavailable operations are as visible as passing capabilities.
- The quick start succeeds from a clean checkout without a live third-party service.
- Generated copy contains no external company, product, funding, or market-positioning theme.
- A stale generated overview fails continuous integration.

## Dependencies

Depends on #435 and consumes #457 and #474 as their generated data lands.

## Verification

Build the overview twice, compare normalized output, run every copied command in temporary repositories, and fail a fixture capability to prove the page cannot claim success.
